args.body:
Dear Outside Counsel,

Please find attached the consolidated Contract X correspondence bundle for your review.

The attached PDF (CONSOLIDATED_CONTRACTX_BUNDLE.pdf) includes the complete email thread regarding Contract X:

1. Original email from vendor@vendor.com (Oct 3) - Subject: "Contract X draft"
2. Discussion email from leadnegotiator@company.com (Oct 10) - Subject: "Re: Contract X - discussion and notes"
3. Notification from legal-assistant@company.com (Oct 10) - Subject: "Contract X: compiled bundles (full and redacted)"

This bundle contains all correspondence in chronological order.

Please let me know if you have any questions or require additional materials.

Best regards,

Me
